tasks.title: Thrust-to-weight ratio
tasks.statement: The aircraft's takeoff mass with battery is **{m} kg**, the maximum static thrust of one motor with its prop is **{t} g**, and there are four motors. Find the thrust-to-weight ratio T/W.
tasks.solution: T/W = 4·t / (1000·m). It's the ratio of the total maximum thrust to the weight; freestyle needs ≥ 4–5, a cargo aircraft ≈ 2.

tasks.title: Hover throttle
tasks.statement: Mass **{m} kg**, four motors, maximum thrust of one motor **{t} g**. What fraction of its maximum thrust (in percent) must each motor produce at hover?
tasks.solution: At hover the total thrust equals the weight: each motor gives m·1000/4 g, the fraction = (m·1000/4)/t·100 %. The throttle percentage on the OSD will be different — thrust is nonlinear in throttle.
